identifiedBy.fact: Climber.org trip report 2006 lists Trailhead: Agnew Meadow, Rodgers Peak class 2 (via Davis Lakes side)

notes: Single trip report. Rodgers is also reached from Tuolumne Meadows / Lyell Canyon (report 2002/998 started at Happy Isles on a long traverse). Agnew Meadow is the side the SE ridge route uses; USFS point is the Agnew Meadow wildflower trailhead, may be a few hundred m from the main lot. Lower confidence.

notes: No official candidate or OSM point matches Minaret Summit (road summit above Mammoth Mountain, roughly 37.65,-119.09 is my recollection only, not a placement). Other reports 1999/515 and 2000/682 start at Mammoth ski area / Minaret Summit too.
